ctx.x: Well, he was also the -- yeah, well, he's the one that owned all the Chili Bowls, so he opened this nightclub and he stole this band, See Pee C.P. Johnson's band from a club down on -- called the Paradise Club -- on Main Street, downtown Los Angeles. So, he give us about 15, $20 more a week. So, we went to Hollywood.
